description: This Java source file defines a custom preference category class for an Android application, specifically for the Nextcloud Notes Android client. The class customizes the appearance of preference category titles by applying branding colors.

classes.name: BrandedPreferenceCategory
classes.description: A custom preference category that applies branding colors to its title view when binding the view holder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Overrides the method to customize the preference category view by setting the text color of the title based on branding.
